objective: Corroborate the established family case that the 1877 arrangement took effect in 1928, that the full Parcel-A estate included the north forest and south-east green later registered as VG41, and that both areas were seized on 4 July 1955 during WGR's enforcement of Parcel B; then trace those exact areas through later titles and remedies.
closed_control_points: Parcel A is the full 1877 house/quarrying estate: farmhouse/buildings; barn, stable and yard west of the house; garden; forest north of the house; and ground south-east of the house/garden later registered as VG41. The phrase 'house and garden' refers to the remaining occupied centre, not the whole Parcel A.
Parcel B is the separate eastern agricultural fields. The 1939 WGR–John Williams agreement/plan is already obtained and depicts Parcel B only; no repeat acquisition task.

Family title case: the 1877 arrangement took effect in 1928 when quarrying and rent to Thomas ended; Parcel A passed to the Williams family. The alternative limitation case is that 12 years from 1928 would have matured by 1940 if legal conditions were met.

Family account: 1949 was the first later effort to make Mary's Parcel-A occupation appear permissive and failed; the title deed was reported missing in 1950–52; the 1955 'whole farm' wording blurred Parcel A and B, and 4 July 1955 enforcement seized the Parcel-A north forest and south-east green along with Parcel B.
D696 rent books remain background corroboration only unless a specific entry directly concerns Parcel-A forest/green or the 1955 event.

accepted_challenges: Do not treat the missing 1969 root deed/1971 abstract as Parcel-A-specific proof: the gap affects both later conveyance-chain descriptions.

Do not make fraud the entry point. Investigate the 1928 title case, the later conflation of parcels, the 1955 taking and the downstream title extent first; fraud remains contingent on evidence of an identified actor, conduct, knowledge, materiality and causation.

Use the actual 1955 order/process wording to analyse authority, but do not frame the family's account of the forest/green seizure as a blank, unanswered question. The documentary task is to corroborate the event, define the extent and determine how the 'whole farm' wording was used.
Keep the 1962 farmhouse-and-garden proceedings in their proper scope: they concern the remaining occupied house group, not the whole geographical extent of Parcel A.
Record when and how the family-held 1938 conveyance and 1939 papers entered family custody and whether they were available in 1986–87; non-production is not proof of concealment.
Read the 1905 conveyance, 15 May 1924 agreement and 29 March 1961 deed as a parallel downstream title-root test.
Do not treat WA240304 as the full Parcel A without its plan. Match all historic/current title plans against the full Parcel-A geometry.
Potential indemnity/settlement for built-over land and possible proprietary/protective remedies for the remaining forest/green are distinct and require counsel's assessment.
not_adopted_as_findings: Any allegation of fraud, concealment, deliberate misdescription or government involvement
Any conclusion that the missing 1969 deed means either parcel lacks a valid root
Any conclusion that the VG41 registration was mistaken

family_case_chronology: 1928: 1877 arrangement took effect when quarrying and rent to Thomas ended; full Parcel A passed to the Williams family on the family title case.
1949: first later attempt, on the family's case, to cast Mary's Parcel-A occupation as permissive; the attempt failed.
1950–52: family title deed reported missing after the 1949 effort.

4 July 1955: 'whole farm' wording was used during enforcement of Parcel B; the north forest and south-east green of Parcel A were seized, while Mary held onto the occupied farmhouse/buildings/garden group.

Mary's defence of the remaining occupied centre, after leg amputation and while caring for seven children, including reported threats to her own safety if forcibly removed, is not evidence that she claimed only the house and garden or abandoned the rest of Parcel A.
